critical_code_review_comments: TestStripeCheckout.test_renter_can_create_checkout in p1 suite actually returned 200 with a real checkout.stripe.com URL — sk_test_emergent is fully functional. No fallback skip was needed in this run.

p1_features.has_booking_conflict considers BOTH 'pending' and 'approved' statuses as conflicts at creation time. This means a pending booking can block other pending bookings on the same dates. Confirm this is desired (it does correctly prevent racing pending requests but may surprise users).

Admin update endpoint accepts only fields with non-None values; user cannot use the API to set a flag back to False via this endpoint if Pydantic treats Optional[bool]=None as omitted. The current implementation reads `payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` then filters out None — meaning sending {is_verified: false} works (verified during UI toggle), but sending null would no-op. Acceptable, but worth a doc note.

/api/payments/status/{session_id} returns 500 if Stripe call fails (logger.error then HTTPException(500)). When called with an invalid session_id it leaks Stripe's error via the logger but returns generic 500 to user — acceptable.

Stripe webhook (POST /api/webhook/stripe) silently swallows parse failures and returns {received: false} with 200 OK; Stripe will not retry on 2xx. If we want Stripe to retry on parse failures we should return 400.
